title: 664. Design Search Autocomplete System

examples.input: operations = ["AutocompleteSystem","input","input","input","input"], values = ["i love you:5;island:3;ironman:2;i love leetcode:2", "i", " ", "a", "#"]
examples.output: [["i love you","island","i love leetcode"],["i love you","i love leetcode"],[],[]]
examples.explanation: Prefix "i" matches three sentences by heat; "i " narrows to two; "i a" matches nothing; "#" stores "i a".
Tied heats fall back to ASCII order.

hints: Keep a map from sentence to heat plus a live prefix buffer; preload parses on ':' and ';'.
For a normal character, extend the prefix and collect every stored sentence starting with it.
Sort candidates by heat descending then ASCII ascending, keep three; '#' commits the prefix and resets it.
